description: CDK v2 Python stack (cdk/) defining DynamoDB table, the Python Lambda (engine vendored, no Docker bundling), HTTP API with open CORS and routes, SNS topic, S3 bucket + CloudFront serving web/, IAM grants (bedrock InvokeModel, dynamo RW, sns publish), with env pinned to account 888577033943 / us-east-1. Synthesizes cleanly. Independent of FEAT-001/003 at author time (references their asset dirs).
steps: Create cdk/requirements.txt with aws-cdk-lib>=2.100 and constructs>=10. Create cdk/cdk.json with {"app": "python app.py"}.
Create cdk/app.py: App(); KingaStack(app, 'KingaMajiStack', env=Environment(account='888577033943', region='us-east-1')); app.synth().
Create cdk/kinga_stack.py KingaStack(Stack). DynamoDB Table 'reports': partition_key settlement (STRING), sort_key timestamp (STRING), billing_mode PAY_PER_REQUEST, removal_policy DESTROY.

Lambda Function 'analyze': runtime PYTHON_3_13, handler 'handler.handler', code=Code.from_asset(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),'..','lambda')) with NO bundling, timeout Duration.seconds(30), memory_size 512, environment {TABLE_NAME: table.table_name, SNS_TOPIC_ARN: topic.topic_arn, MODEL_ID: 'amazon.nova-lite-v1:0'}.

HTTP API via aws_apigatewayv2.HttpApi 'kinga-api' with cors_preflight allow_origins ['*'], allow_methods ANY, allow_headers ['*']. Add routes POST /analyze, GET /reports, POST /seed, GET /health using HttpLambdaIntegration (aws_apigatewayv2_integrations) all pointing at the Lambda.

S3 Bucket for web (block_public_access ALL, removal_policy DESTROY, auto_delete_objects True). CloudFront Distribution with S3 origin (use S3BucketOrigin/OAC or OAI as available in aws-cdk-lib v2), default_root_object 'index.html', viewer_protocol_policy REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS.
aws_s3_deployment.BucketDeployment deploying Source.asset('../web') to the bucket with distribution + distribution_paths ['/*'] so CloudFront is invalidated on deploy.
CfnOutputs: CloudFrontURL = 'https://' + distribution.distribution_domain_name; ApiUrl = http_api.api_endpoint; TableName; TopicArn.

If web/index.html or lambda/ do not yet exist when authoring this feature, create a minimal placeholder web/index.html and ensure lambda/ has at least handler.py+depth_engine.py before synth (the fixer/integration step vendors the real engine). The stack must synth against whatever assets exist.
acceptance_criteria: cdk/ has app.py, kinga_stack.py, cdk.json, requirements.txt.
Stack env is explicitly account '888577033943' and region 'us-east-1'.
Lambda uses Code.from_asset on ../lambda with runtime PYTHON_3_13 and NO Docker bundling.
IAM grants include bedrock:InvokeModel (nova-lite + nova-pro ARNs), dynamodb RW, sns publish.
HTTP API defines POST /analyze, GET /reports, POST /seed, GET /health with open CORS.
cdk synth succeeds and produces a CloudFormation template.
verification: cp engine/depth_engine.py lambda/depth_engine.py  (ensure asset is complete before synth)
cd cdk && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
cdk synth KingaMajiStack >/dev/null && echo SYNTH_OK  (must print SYNTH_OK with no error)
grep -q '888577033943' cdk.out/KingaMajiStack.template.json && grep -qi 'bedrock:InvokeModel' cdk.out/KingaMajiStack.template.json && echo ENV_AND_IAM_OK
findings:
DONE. Created cdk/{app.py, kinga_stack.py, cdk.json, requirements.txt}. Stack env pinned Environment(account='888577033943', region='us-east-1') in app.py. SYNTH_OK + ENV_AND_IAM_OK (888577033943 and bedrock:InvokeModel both present in cdk.out/KingaMajiStack.template.json).

RESOURCE LOGICAL NAMES (template): DynamoDB ReportsTable (PK settlement S, SK timestamp S, PAY_PER_REQUEST, DESTROY). SNS AlertsTopic (display_name 'kinga-alerts'). Lambda AnalyzeFunction (Runtime python3.13, handler handler.handler, Code.from_asset('../lambda') NO bundling, timeout 30s, memory 512, env TABLE_NAME/SNS_TOPIC_ARN/MODEL_ID=amazon.nova-lite-v1:0). IAM: table.grant_read_write_data + topic.grant_publish + explicit PolicyStatement bedrock:InvokeModel on both foundation-model ARNs (nova-lite + nova-pro, empty account segment). HTTP API KingaApi (api_name 'kinga-api', cors_preflight allow_origins['*'] methods ANY headers['*']); 4 routes POST /analyze, GET /reports, POST /seed, GET /health via one HttpLambdaIntegration (AnalyzeIntegration). S3 WebBucket (BLOCK_ALL, DESTROY, auto_delete_objects). CloudFront WebDistribution with origins.S3BucketOrigin.with_origin_access_control (OAC), default_root_object index.html, REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS. s3deploy BucketDeployment DeployWeb (Source.asset('../web'), distribution + distribution_paths ['/*'] => invalidation). CfnOutputs: CloudFrontURL ('https://'+distribution_domain_name), ApiUrl (http_api.api_endpoint), TableName, TopicArn. Template resource counts: 3 Lambda functions (analyze + 2 CDK custom-resource helpers for BucketDeployment & auto-delete — expected), 4 routes, OAC, 1 bucket, 1 distribution.

PLACEHOLDERS: web/index.html created as minimal placeholder (has __API_URL__ marker) so synth has an asset; FEAT-003 replaces it. lambda/ already had handler.py (FEAT-001) + re-vendored depth_engine.py (cp engine/depth_engine.py lambda/depth_engine.py).

IMPORT QUIRKS / TOOLING (IMPORTANT for deploy): S3 OAC uses aws_cloudfront_origins.S3BucketOrigin.with_origin_access_control (present in current aws-cdk-lib). CRITICAL CLI/LIB MISMATCH: the GLOBAL cdk CLI is 2.1033.0 which only reads cloud-assembly schema <=48, but every aws-cdk-lib version that still exposes Runtime.PYTHON_3_13 emits schema 54 (checked 2.16x-2.272; schema 54 goes back past 2.168, PYTHON_3_13 absent below ~2.172, so NO lib satisfies both). FIX: installed a LOCAL CLI in cdk/ via `npm install --no-save aws-cdk@latest` (-> 2.1144.0, supports schema 54) and ran synth with PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH". requirements.txt pinned aws-cdk-lib>=2.272,<2.273 (synthesized with 2.272.0) + constructs<11, with a header comment documenting the local-CLI requirement. DEPLOY STEP (FEAT-004/scripts) MUST use the local CLI, not the global one. .gitignore updated to exclude cdk/node_modules, package-lock.json, package.json, .venv, cdk.out, and transient *_err.log.

VERIFICATION (per FEAT-002, all pass): AWS_PROFILE=simi-ops AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1; cp engine->lambda; python3 -m venv cdk/.venv; pip install -r requirements.txt; `cdk synth KingaMajiStack` -> SYNTH_OK (via local CLI); grep 888577033943 && grep -i bedrock:InvokeModel in template -> ENV_AND_IAM_OK.
